notes: Currency assumptions: 2022-24 USD->EUR 0.925; 2025-26 USD->EUR 0.86; DKK->EUR 0.134. Conversions are approximations.
own_industry_share for all countries except USA (and EU institutional rules) is a modelled range (certainty C); no government publishes a domestic-procurement share of Ukraine aid.
Kiel (Aug 2025): Europe allocated >=EUR 35.1bn via procurement through June 2025, contracts 'primarily' to European and Ukrainian firms - no per-country split.

Kiel KPB203: procurement in Ukraine rose from 4% (H2 2024) to 12% (H1 2025) and 22% (H2 2025) of procurement-based aid; >=11 donors fund Ukrainian production. Ukraine MoD: USD 6.1bn foreign money for Ukrainian production in 2025, ~USD 1.8bn via Danish model.
PURL: USD 6.7bn from 29 countries by 2026-07-23 (KMU); EUR 3.7bn in 2025 (Kiel). >90% of PURL equipment from US stocks; ~95% of Patriot interceptors reaching Ukraine come via PURL.
Czech initiative: ~4-4.4m large-calibre rounds delivered (2024: 1.5m, 2025: 1.8m); ~1m contracted for 2026; donors fell 18->9; mostly bought from non-EU producers.
Stock-based aid and its backfill: when donors give from stocks and replenish from foreign suppliers (e.g. Poland->Korea, many->US), the flowback goes abroad with a lag; not quantified.
